CustomField.description: Per-template opt-in for the "Decline to Sign" button (#367). Default FALSE — Decline is hidden unless explicitly turned on for this template AND the org-wide setting (Signature_Show_Decline__c on DocGen_Settings__c) is also on. Both must be true for Decline to appear; this field has no effect while the org-wide setting is off. Requests with no template at all (raw source-document sends) are gated by the org-wide setting alone.
CustomField.label: Show Decline Button
